title: 第十九章 十三太保的伊始第二十章 王妈博彩第三弹上
lines: 阳光明媚，碧波粼粼，明湖湖畔风景极为优美，湖畔另一侧的庄园，映在碧蓝湖水中，亭榭楼宇，便如海市蜃楼一般虚幻华美。
这一侧的湖畔，却是十几个汉子，光着膀子沿着湖畔气喘吁吁的跑着，一个个累得东倒西歪的，看起来，都恨不得软瘫在地上再不起来。
只不过，陆宁大马金刀的在一旁坐着，旁边一柄寒意森森的陌刀，刀柄插入地中尺许左右，远远看着那森森刀刃，就令人头皮瘆得慌。
国主第下更不是什么讲理的人，若不按他吩咐，足额的完成所谓的“训练”，只怕真会被他一刀砍了脑袋。
共十三个汉子，有陆平、陆霸、陆贵、陆青四恶奴，其余九人，都是佃户中没有妻儿的健硕青年，而且，都已经自愿成为国主的部曲，也就是私奴。
国主第下坐的椅子比寻常胡床椅腿更长，是国主第下自己做的，这段时间，听说国主第下在庄园中，很是做了些稀奇古怪的东西。
尤老三一脸谄笑的在陆宁身侧站着。
尤老三这段时间，就好像热锅上的蚂蚁，他原本，帮刘家收一些外围田租，可现在，好像被一脚踢到了一边。
而且，更可怖的是，他曾经吆喝过国主第下，看起来，国主第下对他有了成见，他真怕这位小国主哪天一时兴起，将他剁成肉酱扔东海里喂鱼。
这段时间，一直也没见到妹妹，给她写信也没有回音，尤老三实在忍耐不住，便也颠颠跑来了明湖，却不想，正遇到国主第下在操练部曲。
看着这些被操练的死去活来的奴仆，尤老三就觉得蛋疼，心说换了自己，还不如死了算了。
“停！”陆宁突然喊了一声。
那十三个苦命娃，简直如蒙大赦，立刻一个个的瘫倒在地，大口的喘息。
尤老三在旁苦笑，国主第下的所谓训练项目，他听不太懂，什么训练耐力的负重千丈长跑，什么训练臂力腰腹之力的举重，还有什么俯卧撑、仰卧起坐、引体向上等等，花样许多。
而休息时间，这些汉子便是练习骑乘，听说国主第下买了数十匹好马，建了马场，请了北方的马倌圈养。
江畔这一边，被国主平出一个空旷场地，场地之中，有中间绑着铁棍的成对石锁，有铁器铸造的高高横杆，各种重量不一的石锁铁锁等等，都是国主第下鼓捣出来的所谓“训练器械”。
而且听闻，这只是训练之开始，以后随着这些部曲体质增强，训练强度还要加码。
这是，要练出一个个蛮牛吗？尤老三心里暗暗咋舌。
“一刻钟后，每人再做一百个俯卧撑！然后休息，准备吃午饭！”陆宁指了指身侧沙漏，上面陆宁自己刻的刻度，沙漏一刻钟的时间，按照陆宁估算，大概在五分钟左右。
瘫躺在地的汉子们，心里都是叫苦不迭。
不过，这十三个汉子，都受过国主第下大恩，四个恶奴，本来是要被砍头，已经是死定的人，其余九人，也各有际遇，都因为国主第下，有的才留下了性命，有的家人血冤得洗，或是亲友得救，是以，不管多苦多累，他们都在拼命坚持。
本就该现在在地狱里了，是国主第下救下了他们，现在的地狱式训练，又算得什么？
所以，当陆宁慢条斯理用小锤敲打身旁皮鼓，宣布时间到后。
这十三个苦命娃，便又都勉力起身，摘去腿上绑着的麻布沙袋，趴在地上，开始做俯卧撑。
远方湖畔小路，一行黑点慢慢行来，叽叽喳喳的声音，却是莺莺燕燕。
是尤五娘领着一队婢女，拎了食盒而来。
少女清香随着轻风飘入这些苦命娃的鼻端，莺莺燕燕的娇俏声音传入他们耳中，死狗一样的家伙们，突然又有了力气，拼命的做着俯卧撑，自己做一个，便吼一声数字，人人都知道，主公眼观六路，谁也偷不得懒，虚报者会被重罚。
“主君，您还是在此用膳吗？”尤五娘来到陆宁身前，娇滴滴的问，她轻轻俯身，红彤彤齐胸襦裙中，那诱人的雪白深深沟壑，就在陆宁眼旁。
陆宁笑笑，说：“照旧吧。”
已经训练了十几天时间，每天陆宁都是和他的“十三太保”一样，在这湖畔进食。
陆宁心情不错，思及老妈虽然还气鼓鼓不愿意见二姐，但明显心内已经软了，假以时日，这心结终究能解开。
尤五娘将手中食盒放在陆宁旁侧矮桌上，取出食盒里面菜肴，却是极为清淡，几道小蔬而已。
陆宁也是没办法，他虽然不看重口舌之欲，但对肉食也不排斥，不过最近每次用了肉食，他都会好像有使不完的力气要发泄一番，不然就感觉心里堵得慌难受异常。
就好像，被雷劈穿越而来，令他的代谢系统产生了某种异变，有了数倍的放大效果，仅仅一点素食热量就可以满足他现今的生理需求。
旁侧尤老三，对尤五娘使眼色，见妹妹理也不理自己，就好像没看到自己一样，心里只是徒唤奈何。
不过看妹妹，好像混的还不错，既能在国主第下面前说上话，而且好像还是带来的这些婢女的头头，她吩咐下，那些婢女做事。
content_en:
The sun is shining, the blue waves are sparkling, and the scenery along Minghu Lake is extremely beautiful. The manor on the other side of the lake, with its pavilions and buildings reflected in the blue water, is as illusory and gorgeous as a mirage.
"One, two!"
On this side of the lake, there were more than a dozen men, shirtless and panting, running along the lake. They were all staggering from exhaustion and looked like they wanted to collapse on the ground and never get up again.
However, Lu Ning was sitting beside him with his golden sword, and next to him was a cold Mo Dao. The handle of the knife was inserted about a foot into the ground. Looking at the cold blade from a distance, it made people feel terrified.
The second emperor of the country is not a reasonable person. If you don't follow his instructions and complete the so-called "training" in full, I'm afraid he will really cut off your head with a knife.
There are a total of thirteen men, including the four evil slaves Lu Ping, Lu Ba, Lu Gui, and Lu Qing. The remaining nine are all strong young men who have no wives and children among the tenants. Moreover, they have all voluntarily become part of the king, that is, private slaves.
The chair that the emperor is sitting on has longer legs than the ordinary bed chair. It was made by the emperor himself. During this period, I heard that the emperor made some weird things in the manor.
You Laosan stood beside Lu Ning with a flattering smile on his face.
You Laosan has been like an ant on a hot pot during this period. He originally helped the Liu family collect some peripheral land rent, but now, it seems that he has been kicked aside.
What's more terrifying is that he once yelled at the king. It seems that the king has a prejudice against him. He is really afraid that the little king will chop him into meat paste and throw him into the East China Sea to feed the fish.
During this period of time, I haven't seen my sister, and I haven't received any reply when I wrote to her. You Laosan couldn't bear it anymore, so he ran to Minghu, but he didn't expect that he met the king's subordinate practicing the song.
Looking at these slaves who were trained to death, You Laosan felt a pain in his balls and thought to himself that it would be better to die if it were him.
"Stop!" Lu Ning suddenly shouted.
Those thirteen poor children, as if they had been granted amnesty, immediately collapsed to the ground one by one, gasping for air.
You Laosan smiled bitterly at the side. He couldn't quite understand the so-called training items given by the emperor. They included long-distance running with weights to train endurance, weightlifting to train arm strength, waist and abdominal strength, and push-ups, sit-ups, pull-ups, etc. There were many tricks.
During the break, these men practiced riding. It was said that the emperor bought dozens of good horses, built a horse farm, and hired horsemen from the north to keep them.
On this side of the river, the king created an open field. In the field, there were pairs of stone locks with iron rods tied in the middle, tall horizontal bars made of iron, various stone locks and iron locks of different weights, etc., which were all so-called "training equipment" tinkered by the king.
And I heard that this is just the beginning of the training. In the future, as the physical fitness of these parts increases, the training intensity will be increased.
This is, do you want to train to become a bull? You Laosan was secretly speechless.
"In a quarter of an hour, each person will do another hundred push-ups! Then take a rest and get ready for lunch!" Lu Ning pointed to the hourglass beside him. Lu Ning had carved the scale on it. According to Lu Ning's estimate, the time for a quarter of an hour was about five minutes.
The men lying paralyzed on the ground were complaining in their hearts.
However, these thirteen men had all been greatly favored by the emperor. The four evil slaves were originally going to be beheaded and were already destined to die. The remaining nine people also had their own circumstances. Some of them survived because of the emperor. Some of their family members had their blood wrongs washed away, or their relatives and friends were saved. Therefore, no matter how painful or tiring they were, they persisted desperately.
They should be in hell now, but it was the king who saved them, so what does the hellish training mean now?
So, when Lu Ning slowly hit the drum beside him with a small hammer, he announced that the time was up.
The thirteen poor children then managed to get up, took off the linen sandbags tied to their legs, lay down on the ground, and began to do push-ups.
On the lakeside path in the distance, a line of black dots walked slowly, and the chirping sounds were of warblers and swallows.
It was You Wuniang who led a group of maids and brought food boxes.
The fragrance of girls drifted into the noses of these poor children with the breeze, and the delicate voices of orioles and swallows reached their ears. The dead dog-like guys suddenly gained strength again, doing push-ups desperately, doing one by themselves, and then yelled out the number. Everyone knew that the Lord had an eye on all directions, and no one could be lazy. Those who falsely reported would be severely punished.
"My lord, are you still dining here?" You Wuniang came to Lu Ning and asked delicately. She gently leaned over, and the alluring snow-white deep ravine in the red chest-length skirt was right next to Lu Ning's eyes.
Lu Ning smiled and said, "Let's continue as usual."
He has been training for more than ten days, and every day Lu Ning eats by the lake like his "Thirteen Taibao".
Lu Ning was in a good mood, thinking that although her mother was still angry and unwilling to see her second sister, her heart had obviously softened. Given time, the knot in her heart would eventually be resolved.
You Wuniang placed the food box in her hand on the low table next to Lu Ning and took out the dishes in the food box. However, they were extremely light, just a few small vegetables.
Lu Ning couldn't help it. Although he didn't value the desire for words, he was not averse to meat. However, every time he ate meat recently, he seemed to have endless energy to vent, otherwise he would feel extremely congested and uncomfortable.
It was as if being struck by lightning and traveling through time had caused some kind of mutation in his metabolic system, which had an amplification effect several times. Just a few vegetarian calories could meet his current physiological needs.
Next to you, You Lao San winked at You Wuniang. Seeing that his sister ignored him, it was as if she didn't see him, and she was just asking for help.
But looking at my sister, she seems to be doing pretty well. Not only can she speak in front of the king, but she also seems to be the leader of these maids. She gave the order
